verses.1:
A prayer of David.
 Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea;
 listen to my cry.
 Give ear to my prayer—
 it comes from lips free of deceit.
verses.2:
May my vindication come from Your presence;
 may Your eyes see what is right.
verses.4:
As for the deeds of men —
 by the word of Your lips
 I have avoided the ways of the violent.
verses.5:
My steps have held to Your paths;
 my feet have not slipped.
verses.6:
I call on You, O God,
 for You will answer me.
 Incline Your ear to me;
 hear my words.
verses.7:
Show the wonders of Your loving devotion,
 You who save by Your right hand
 those who seek refuge from their foes.
verses.8:
Keep me as the apple of + 17:8 Literally as the pupil, the daughter of Your eye;
 hide me in the shadow of Your wings
verses.9:
from the wicked who assail me,
 from my mortal enemies who surround me.
verses.10:
They have closed their callous hearts;
 their mouths speak with arrogance.
verses.11:
They have tracked us down, and now surround us;
 their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
verses.12:
like a lion greedy for prey,
 like a young lion lurking in ambush.
verses.14:
from such men, O LORD, by Your hand—
 from men of the world
 whose portion is in this life.
 May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones + 17:14 Or May what You have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies and satisfy their sons,
 so they leave their abundance to their children.
verses.15:
As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness;
 when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
